title: Bookshelf
description: A small reading-list SaaS: readers save books, track progress and get weekly reading digests. Next.js front end, Postgres, a background worker and a few third-party APIs.

components.label: Reader
components.description: A signed-in person who keeps a reading list.

components.label: Scheduler
components.description: Fires the weekly digest job every Monday morning.

components.label: Library page
components.description: Shows the reader's shelves and reading progress. Server-rendered, with a client-side shelf editor.

components.label: Add-book dialog
components.description: Search box that looks a book up by title or ISBN and adds it to a shelf.

components.label: Auth
components.description: Signs readers in with email magic links and keeps the session cookie.

components.label: Books API
components.description: REST endpoints to list, add, move and rate books. Every call is scoped to the signed-in reader.

components.label: Catalog lookup
components.description: Turns a title or ISBN into clean book metadata and caches the answer.

components.label: Digest job
components.description: Builds each reader's weekly summary (pages read, next up) and hands it to the mailer.

components.label: Mailer
components.description: Renders and sends transactional e-mails: magic links and the weekly digest.

components.label: Postgres
components.description: Readers, books, shelves and reading events.

components.label: Metadata cache
components.description: Keeps catalog answers for 30 days to stay under the provider's rate limit.

components.label: Open Library
components.description: Public book metadata API (titles, authors, covers).

tour.title: A reader opens their library
tour.description: The page is rendered on the server: it asks the Books API for the reader's shelves, which checks the session and reads Postgres.

tour.title: They add a book by ISBN
tour.description: The dialog posts to the Books API. The catalog lookup answers from the cache when it can, otherwise from Open Library, then the book lands on a shelf.

tour.title: Monday: the weekly digest
tour.description: The scheduler wakes the digest job, which reads each reader's progress, renders an e-mail and hands it to the provider.

tour.title: Signing in
tour.description: Readers sign in with a magic link: Auth.js creates a session row and asks the mailer to send the link.
